# `tool_search`

> Profile: core · Permission key: `[permission] tool_search`

Discover tools not in the core profile (apply_patch, memory, schedule, swarm, web, browser, github, lsp, git_*, plan, …) and activate them for this session. Actions: search (keywords), select (name or comma-separated names), list (activated + deferred catalogue).

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | one of `search`, `select`, `list` | no | search \| select \| list (default search) |
| `max_results` | integer | no | Max search hits (default 8) |
| `query` | string | no | Keywords for search, or tool name(s) for select (comma-separated) |
